title: Policy and External Affairs Executive - VIE Contract
desc:
Policy and External Affairs Executive - VIE Contract

• Location: Ireland, Dublin

• Target start date: 01/02/2027

iMove, the Sanofi VIE Program, is available to citizens of the European Economic Area (EU + Norway, Liechtenstein and Iceland) aged between 18 and 28.

PLEASE NOTE that since this program is primarily an international development program, candidates cannot apply to a VIE assignment in their own country of citizenship.

PLEASE NOTE that applications that are only submitted in French cannot be considered by our non-French speaking partners at Sanofi worldwide. Therefore, only applications that are submitted in English will be considered. Please make sure to apply with your personal email address.

About the job

As Policy and External Affairs Executive VIE within our Public Affairs team, you’ll provide support to policy and related activities surrounding Patient Advocacy groups.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Ready to get started?

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main responsibilities:

• Support compliance related backup of all policy and external affairs work.
• Deliver external policy events targeted at Policy stakeholders.
• Drive internal Policy campaigns and education around One Sanofi.
• Support stakeholder development and joint and collaborative working.
• Provide support to Policy lead on strategic projects by business function.

About you

Experience:

• Background in communications/PR/Policy would be an advantage.

Soft and technical skills:

• Interpersonal communication and advisory skills.
• Analytical and synthesis skills.
• Teamwork and autonomy.
• Proactivity and creativity.
• Knowledge of Digital & Creative Tools.
• Content creation for internal and external communication
• Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite: Excel, PowerPoint, Word.

Education:

• Master’s degree in business /management or a relevant field.

Languages:

• Fluent English (verbal and written).

Why choose us?

• Be part of a pioneering biopharma company where patient insights shape drug development.
• Work at the forefront of AI-powered science that accelerates discovery and improves outcomes.
• Collaborate beyond your expertise, sparking new ideas with diverse, multidisciplinary teams.
• Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year.
• Thrive in inclusive, flexible workplaces that support your personal and professional well-being.
• Launch your career with a company that invests in you — and empowers you to reimagine what’s possible.
• Build your future with access to the latest tools, digital innovation, and continuous learning that keep you ahead of the curve.

iMove is a unique program tailored for European youth interested in challenging themselves with meaningful assignments across the globe. At Sanofi we have a strong ambition to invest in young talents who will drive the success of Sanofi tomorrow.
Sanofi’s Work Abroad Program, iMove, offers jobs-assignments with actual responsibilities and a perspective to grow. We provide those opportunities in various functions such as: marketing, finance, regulatory, supply chain, clinical trials, production, etc. and in more than 40 countries. Sanofi unites people who are passionate about solving healthcare needs across the world. Joining our iMove Work Abroad Program is a unique opportunity to make a difference through your work.

#LI-EUR

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ability or gender identity.

Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

title: Junior Berater (d/m/w) Wealth Management Berlin
desc:
Job Description:

Über den Bereich

In der Privatkundenbank bündelt die Deutsche Bank ihre Expertise im Privatkundengeschäft in einem Geschäftsbereich – mit den Marken Deutsche Bank und Postbank als Marktführer in Deutschland und einem globalen Netzwerk, die das Geschäft der Bank mit vermögenden Kund*innen weltweit sowie mit Privatkund*innen und kleinen bis mittelgroßen Unternehmen umfasst.

In ihrem Heimatmarkt Deutschland wie auch international bietet die Privatkundenbank ihren Kund*innen hochwertige Finanzdienstleistungen aus einer Hand – von umfassenden Angeboten für Privatkund*innen über die Betreuung anspruchsvoller Unternehmer und ihrer Familien bis hin zu Lösungen für kleinere und mittelgroße Unternehmen in wichtigen Märkten der Eurozone.

Die Privatkundenbank ist neben der Unternehmensbank, der Investmentbank und dem Asset Management mit ihrem Vermögensverwalter DWS eine der vier Geschäftsbereiche des Deutsche-Bank-Konzerns. Die Deutsche Bank ist Deutschlands führende Bank mit globalem Netzwerk und fest verwurzelt in Europa.

Wir führen unser Wealth Management in Deutschland mit dem Ziel, die unangefochtene, führende Privatkundenbank in Deutschland zu sein. Wir sind Marktführer und sehen aufgrund unserer ausgezeichneten Stellung im Markt, der großen Qualität unserer Mitarbeiter*innen und unserer breiten Angebotspalette weiteres Wachstumspotential. Zusätzlich stärken wir die Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Unternehmensbank, um Unternehmer*innen – privat und geschäftlich – zu bedienen. Für außerordentlich vermögende Kund*innen treten wir dabei mit der im Markt führenden Marke Deutsche Bank Wealth Management auf.

Wir streben eine „Culture of Excellence“ an.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie betreuen ein eigenes Kundenportfolio im Segment Wealth Management mit dem Auftrag, durch das Führen von strukturierten Strategiegesprächen Kundenbedarfe und -potentiale systematisch zu erkennen und zu heben, sowie insbesondere einfache Bedarfe abschließend zu beraten bzw. bei erkennbaren komplexen Bedarfen an erfahrene Wealth Management Berater oder Spezialisten weiterzuleiten.
• Ihre Kernkompetenz ist die Vermögensanlageberatung. Im Sinne des ganzheitlichen Ansatzes umfasst dies die Beratung zu sämtlichen (Wertpapier-)Produkten und Dienstleistungen in Wealth Management.
• Mit Ihren verkäuferischen Fähigkeiten führen Sie die Beratung der Kunden bei einfachen Bedarfen erfolgreich zum Abschluss bzw. leiten Kunden für komplexere Beratung an erfahrene Wealth Management Berater oder Spezialisten weiter.
• Sie beraten ganzheitlich, die regulatorischen Anforderungen an das Wertpapiergeschäft berücksichtigend und führen strukturierte Strategiegespräche unter Einsatz der zur Verfügung stehenden Tools, Prozesse und Hilfsmittel.
• Die Entwicklung Ihrer Kompetenz am Kunden bringen Sie durch regelmäßigen Austausch und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Teammitgliedern und z.B. mittels Tandemgesprächen voran. Sie pflegen die persönliche Kundenbeziehung mit dem Ziel der langfristigen Kundenbindung.

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

• Sie haben eine Ausbildung zur Bankkauffrau/zum Bankkaufmann, eine weiterführende Ausbildung und/oder Studium sind wünschenswert.
• Sie haben Beratungserfahrung im Privatkundenbereich und bringen umfassende Kenntnisse zum MiFiD-konformen Beratungsprozess und zum Produktspektrum ein.
• Ihre fundierten Kenntnisse im Bereich Investments inkl. Finanzmarktentwicklungen sowie Ihre guten Erfahrungen in der Terminvereinbarung zur Ausschöpfung der Kundenpotentiale ergänzen Ihre Kompetenzen.
• Sie zeigen ein hohes Maß an Kunden- und Serviceorientierung und Ihr Auftreten den Kunden gegenüber ist souverän, kompetent und freundlich.
• Sie haben Freude daran im Team zu arbeiten, zeigen Eigeninitiative und Durchsetzungsvermögen.
• Sie nutzen KI-Tools nachweislich effektiv, um Produktivität zu erhöhen, Prozesse zu optimieren und Geschäftsprobleme zu lösen. Dabei treffen Sie fundierte Entscheidungen und gewährleisten einen verantwortungsvollen sowie gewissenhaften Umgang mit Daten und KI-Ergebnissen.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Wir bieten eine breite Palette von Leistungen, die all Ihre beruflichen und persönlichen Bedürfnisse abdecken.

• Emotional ausgeglichen
Eine positive Haltung hilft uns, die Herausforderungen des Alltags zu meistern – beruflich wie privat. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Beratung in schwierigen Lebenssituationen und Angeboten zur Förderung mentaler Gesundheit.

• Körperlich fit
Mit Angeboten zur Aufrechterhaltung Ihrer persönlichen Gesundheit und einem förderlichen beruflichen Umfeld hilft Ihnen die Bank, körperlich fit zu bleiben. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie umfangreichen Check-up Untersuchungen, Impfangeboten und Beratung zur gesunden Lebensführung.

• Sozial vernetzt
Der Austausch mit anderen eröffnet uns neue Perspektiven, bringt uns beruflich wie persönlich voran und stärkt unser Selbstvertrauen und Wohlbefinden. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Unterstützung durch den pme Familienservice, das FitnessCenter Job, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle (bspw. Teilzeit, Jobtandem, hybrides Arbeiten) sowie von Programmen zur Förderung von Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Teilhabe.

• Finanziell abgesichert
Die Bank sichert Sie nicht nur während Ihrer aktiven Karriere, sondern auch für die Zukunft finanziell ab und unterstützt Ihre Flexibilität sowie Mobilität – egal ob privat oder beruflich. Profitieren Sie von Angeboten wie Beitragsplänen für Altersvorsorge, Bankdienstleistungen für Mitarbeiter*innen, Firmenfahrrad oder dem Deutschlandticket und nutzen Sie exklusive Mitarbeiterkonditionen und individuelle Beratung durch die Mitarbeiterbank.

Da die Benefits je nach Standort geringfügig variieren, gehen Sie bitte bei konkreten Fragen auf Ihren Recruiter / Ihre Recruiterin zu.

Die Stelle wird in Voll- und in Teilzeit angeboten.

Bei Fragen zum Rekrutierungsprozess steht Ihnen Melanie Klopsch gerne zur Verfügung.
Kontakt Melanie Klopsch, Telefonnummer: 030 3407-2861

title: Stagiaire Qualité Opérationnelle
desc:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
A Day in the Life
Operational quality intern
Soulager la douleur, rétablir la santé et prolonger la vie : c’est guidé par cette mission que Medtronic continue de faire bénéficier ses thérapies innovantes à des millions de patients. Aujourd’hui, l’opportunité vous est donnée d’intégrer l’une des plus grandes entreprises de dispositifs médicaux au monde et de participer à ce défi quotidien. En rejoignant nos équipes, vous serez au cœur de nos valeurs !

Notre site de production de Pont-de-Claix est l'un des leaders mondiaux dans la fabrication d'aiguilles de suture chirurgicales en termes de coût, de délai, de flexibilité et de qualité. La totalité de la production — 110 millions d'aiguilles fabriquées chaque année — est envoyée dans les usines d'assemblage du groupe, situées en République dominicaine et aux États-Unis.

Le site de production emploie environ 200 personnes.

Contexte

En tant que stagiaire en qualité opérationnelle, vous aurez la charge de l’évaluation et de l’optimisation des tests de validation des inspections visuelles (KappaTest). Vous aurez également diverses responsabilités transversales sur le thème de la qualité opérationnelle.

Notre usine de Pont-de-Claix est spécialisée dans la fabrication d’aiguilles de suture chirurgicales, des dispositifs médicaux soumis à de fortes exigences de qualité dans un contexte réglementaire demandant la plus grande rigueur.

Vous intégrerez l’équipe Qualité Opérationnelle, composée de 8 collaborateurs : 4 ingénieurs et techniciens qualités affectées aux lignes de production (3 en journée et 1 de nuit), 1 alternante et 3 collaborateurs en horaires postés, dédiés notamment aux activités de libération de lot.

Vos missions

• Évaluer, rationaliser et optimiser l'ensemble des tests de validation des inspections visuelles (KappaTest) afin d'améliorer leur efficacité, leur robustesse et leur traçabilité.
- Réaliser une analyse complète du processus actuel de validation, incluant la gestion des échantillons physiques et l'enregistrement des résultats dans la base de données Access, afin d'identifier les opportunités de simplification, d'automatisation et de réduction des tâches à faible valeur ajoutée.
- L'objectif est de réduire les manipulations manuelles, de renforcer la traçabilité des évaluations et d'optimiser le temps consacré à l'exécution et à la correction des KappaTests.

• Organiser et/ou participer à des classes de correction des KappaTests avec les opérateurs.

• Rédiger et/ou participer à la rédaction des procédures et instructions qualité.

Tâches transversales

• Conduire et/ou participer activement aux analyses des causes des déviations qualité et à l'élaboration des actions correctives.
• S'assurer de la bonne application des procédures du système qualité et en faciliter la mise en œuvre.
• Participer aux actions liées à la politique qualité du groupe.
• Participer au développement et à l'amélioration du système qualité.

Votre profil

Vous êtes en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou de Master, avec une spécialisation dans un domaine technique, la qualité, la gestion de projet ou l’amélioration continue.

Vous disposez idéalement des compétences suivantes :

• Outils informatiques : maîtrise d’Excel indispensable ; la connaissance d’Access serait un plus.

• Qualité et validation : des connaissances en validation et en environnement qualité constituent un atout.

• Gestion de projet : une première connaissance de la méthodologie DMAIC et de ses différentes étapes serait appréciée.

• Outils qualité : vous connaissez idéalement des outils d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes tels que les 5 Pourquoi et les 6M (Ishikawa).

• Pilotage de projet : vous êtes familiarisé(e) avec le suivi de projet et les revues de jalons.

Vos qualités personnelles

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personnalité qui saura s'intégrer à l'équipe et mener ses missions avec engagement :

• Rigueur et précision dans la réalisation de vos missions.

• Esprit analytique et capacité à identifier les problématiques et à proposer des solutions.

• Esprit critique et aptitude à analyser la fiabilité et la qualité des données.

• Curiosité, autonomie et adaptabilité pour évoluer dans un environnement industriel.

• Aisance relationnelle et sens de la communication, avec une bonne capacité d'écoute, de partage d'informations et de conviction.

Durée et lieu

• Stage de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027.

• Poste basé à Pont-de-Claix (38).

Pourquoi Medtronic ?

Rejoignez un leader mondial des technologies médicales, où votre travail contribuera à l’excellence opérationnelle et à l’innovation. Bénéficiez d’une expérience pratique dans un environnement dynamique et bienveillant, et ayez un impact réel dès le premier jour.

Prêt(e) à nous aider à façonner l’avenir de la production ? Postulez dès aujourd’hui !

title: Stage - Consultant intéropérabilité (x/f/m) - mars 2027
desc:
Rejoignez une équipe technique de 9 personnes, spécialisée dans l'interopérabilité entre Doctolib et les logiciels métier des structures Salaried & Retail. Vous contribuerez directement à l'amélioration de l'écosystème de santé en facilitant les échanges de données entre les différents systèmes, tout en participant à l'intégration de l'IA et de l'automatisation dans nos processus.

 


VOS MISSIONS

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Participer à la mise en place de connecteurs API utilisant les formats HL7, JSON et FHIR avec les logiciels métier des hôpitaux, centres de santé, centres d'imagerie et magasins d'audio/optique

 - Créer et paramétrer des assistants IA en développant des prompts complexes pour automatiser les processus techniques

 - Contribuer aux travaux d'automatisation de l'équipe en utilisant Python et les technologies d'IA

 - Mettre à jour les processus et la documentation technique pour optimiser les workflows de l'équipe

 - Apporter un support technique aux équipes internes sur les questions d'interopérabilité

 


LES QUALITÉS ATTENDUES POUR CE POSTE

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos besoins, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si :

 - Vous êtes étudiant(e) en école d'ingénieur ou en informatique avec une appétence pour les technologies de santé

 - Vous maîtrisez Python et avez des connaissances en intelligence artificielle et machine learning

 - Vous avez une bonne compréhension des API REST et des architectures de systèmes distribués

 - Vous possédez des compétences en gestion de projet et savez travailler en équipe

 - Vous faites preuve de curiosité technique et d'autonomie dans vos apprentissages

Ce serait fantastique si :

 - Vous avez des connaissances de base en standards HL7 et FHIR utilisés dans le secteur de la santé

 - Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des projets d'automatisation ou d'intégration de systèmes

 - Vous avez une expérience avec les outils de développement collaboratif (Git, CI/CD)

 


NOTRE OFFRE

 - Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

 - Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux 

 - Une offre de sport : un abonnement Urban Sports Club, des cours de sport gratuits dans les bureaux ou à distance

 - Le remboursement des titres de transport à 50%

 - De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être 

 - Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride

 


LE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

 - Un entretien RH avec Aya, Talent Partner (15 minutes)

 - Un entretien opérationnel avec une restitution d'un cas pratique avec deux membres de l'équipe (1 heure)

 - Un entretien de validation avec Nicolas, Technical Deployment Team Manager (30 minutes)


 


DÉTAILS DU POSTE

 - Durée : 6 mois

 - Début souhaité : mars 2027

 - Lieu de travail : Levallois-Perret

 - Gratification : À définir selon le niveau d'études

title: Sales Graduate Program 🇫🇷
desc:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐️ THE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE - GRADUATE PROGRAM ⭐️



We’re excited to open a new opportunity to join Alan's Business Development Representative (BDR) - Graduate Program, offering a remarkable start to a Sales career!

The concept? Over a period of 18-24 months, you’ll have the opportunity to gain essential Sales skills, that will prepare you for more senior positions within the Sales community.

You will work as a Business Development Representative (BDR), where you will learn the fundamentals of Sales:

 - Develop an effective prospecting strategy;

 - Understand the specifics of a market;

 - Spark the interest of a prospect via various channels (email, social networks and cold calls);

 - Book qualitative discovery meetings with C-Levels. 

After 12 months in a market such as Tech, Manufacturing, Retail, or Hospitality, you will change segments to discover new prospecting methods and collaborate with another team.

In your second year, you will continue as a BDR. title: Early Careers - Aerospace and Aeronautical Engineering
desc:
Who we are:

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The Bring Something Amazing Initiative:

Helsing’s mission is to protect our democracies. Delivering sovereign AI and mission-critical software capability requires exceptional engineering talent at every level. Following our recent funding and the success of early-career engineers across our teams—including talent from our Formula Student partnerships—we are opening multiple roles across our London and Munich Physical Products Engineering teams. Traditional recruitment often places artificial barriers in front of early-career builders. Resumes rarely tell the full story of your technical depth, intuition, or drive. To solve this, we are piloting a direct, craft-first hiring path: Bring Something Awesome to Apply (BSA2A).

(This route is designed specifically for early-career engineers. It is entirely optional, you may still apply via our standard job listings if you prefer.)

Please note that candidates will be considered for the office nearest to them but may also be required to relocate.

The Process:

At the core of our technical interview philosophy is Bring Something Awesome (BSA). A dedicated session where candidates present an ambitious technical project they have designed, built, or contributed to.

With BSA2A, we are bringing this step to the very front of the application. Instead of an initial CV and recruiter screen, you apply by submitting a short (maximum 10-minute) prerecorded video walkthrough of something technically compelling you have built. We look for:

• Engineering depth & craft: Technically challenging hardware designs.

• First-principles problem solving: The ability to deconstruct complex technical challenges autonomously.

• Clear technical communication: The ability to explain the how and why behind your trade-offs succinctly.

Candidates selected through BSA2A move into an accelerated, streamlined technical assessment:

• Expression of Interest: Complete the short form below to confirm your eligibility. Our team will review submissions.

• Video Submission: Eligible candidates receive a private link with detailed guidance to upload their 10-minute BSA walkthrough. Every video is evaluated directly by a Helsing engineer, not an algorithm or automated keyword filter.

• Technical Interviews (2 × 60 mins):

Round 1: BSA Deep Dive. An interactive, technical exploration of your project and system trade-offs.

Round 2: Requirements and Design Interview. Practical, real-world scenario and problem-solving task.

Final Interview (30 mins): A conversation with engineering leadership focused on mission alignment, collaboration, and how you work.

Note: The initial form below is simply an expression of interest. You do not need your video recorded to submit this form. If your profile is eligible, we will send you dedicated instructions and a submission window.

Why apply via this route?

• Evaluated on proof of work, not pedigree: Your designs, choices, and technical curiosity take centre stage—not university ranking, buzzwords, or CV formatting.

• Play to your strengths: Your application is assessed directly by Helsing engineers on what you can actually build. Putting your real-world work front and centre gives you the highest signal—and the highest probability of success.

• Accelerated timeline: A focused, high-signal path that bypasses standard preliminary screens and reduces the overall interview cycle by two full stages.

The Role:

At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate, and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so must be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve.

The Day-to-Day:

Find more information on the day-to-day:

Mechanical Designer, Prototyping Engineer, Deployed Hardware Engineer GNC Engineer

*Please note, you need to apply via this page to be considered for the BSA2A process.

You Should Apply If You:

Please note that we do not expect candidates to have experience with all of the points below, however we have outlined areas of relevant experiences

• Have a solid background in airframe design, structural anaylsis or propulsion engineering.

• Are passionate about keeping up to date with current research and enjoy reimplementing / extending concepts on state-of-the-art navigation and guidance algorithms.

• Have built and validated flight dynamics models from first principles, and tested them against real flight or experimental data

• Have proven experience taking concepts to field testing.

• Have planned and executed test campaigns and can close the loop between test data and simulation through systematic model correlation

• Can deliver into complex programmes across major aeronautical…

title: Product Design Intern
desc:
Company Description
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
#Li-Hybrid

Job Description
We are evolving Artemis, Nexthink's Design System, to help the product team deliver consistent, accessible, high-quality experiences across a complex B2B software platform. You will help make our components, interaction patterns, and documentation easier to use and scale.
As an intern you will:

• Review existing Figma libraries, UI patterns, and documentation to identify inconsistencies, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

• Create and refine reusable Figma components, including variants, states, and usage examples, with guidance from the UX team.

• Turn design decisions into clear component specifications, interaction guidelines, and structured documentation.

• Work with designers and engineers to improve design-to-development handover, and explore ways to make it more efficient through tooling and automation.

This internship offers hands-on experience in:

• Contributing to a production design system used by cross-functional product teams; working with Figma, component-driven design, and modern UX documentation practices; and collaborating directly with UX, product management, and engineering colleagues.

You will gain experience in:

• Building scalable UI foundations, documenting interaction patterns, understanding accessibility and consistency requirements, and translating designs into implementation-ready guidance for a real SaaS product.

Qualifications
• Currently studying at university or freshly graduated in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, Digital Humanities, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.
• Familiarity with Figma and basic user interface design principles, with an interest in design systems and reusable components.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills; curiosity, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and collaborate.
Nice to have

• Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS, front-end development, or a framework such as Angular.
• Experience with Figma components, variants, variables, auto layout, or digital accessibility principles.
• Interest in AI-assisted design workflows, design-to-code tooling, or automated documentation.
Previous professional experience is not required. We value curiosity, initiative, and thoughtful problem-solving. It is a paid internship.

Additional Information
We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.
With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

title: (Junior) Customer Service Complaints Agent - German Speaking
desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are looking for a dedicated and competent professional to strengthen our team in the area of Solution Management EU, Customer Service. In this role, you will take on complaint handling, primarily for our German-speaking markets. Do you have a knack for de-escalation, work in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in challenging situations? If you want to drive complex cases forward in a solution-oriented manner and enjoy a constructive error culture, we look forward to receiving your application!

Your Responsibilities

• Complaint Management: You will handle customer complaints independently and on time. In doing so, you act in a solution-oriented and professional manner to ensure customer satisfaction even in difficult cases and a high-frequency environment.

• Root Cause Analysis & Optimization: You systematically analyze the reasons for complaints in order to identify operational weaknesses and initiate sustainable process improvements.

• Solution Orientation: You make well-founded decisions regarding goodwill arrangements within defined guidelines to achieve a fast and satisfactory solution for our customers.

• Quality Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant.

• Risk Assessment: You identify potential operational or legal risks at an early stage and support their minimization.

• Interface Management: You coordinate closely with internal departments (e.g., Product, Operations) to resolve complex issues quickly and in a customer-friendly manner.

Your Profile

• Completed training, ideally in banking or insurance, the legal field, or comparable areas.

• At least 1-2 years of experience in complaint management, customer service, or handling demanding customer inquiries – ideally in the financial services industry or a comparable regulatory environment.

• Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner.

• A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Minimum C1 fluency (written and spoken) in at least one of German or Dutch is required, along with good working proficiency in English (C1). Any additional language skills are a strong plus.

• Good IT skills (especially Google Workspace, Zendesk).

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

• You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

title: (Junior) Customer Service Complaints Agent - German Speaking  (m/f/d)
desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are looking for a dedicated and competent professional to strengthen our team in the area of Solution Management EU, Customer Service. In this role, you will take on complaint handling, primarily for our German-speaking markets. Do you have a knack for de-escalation, work in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in challenging situations? If you want to drive complex cases forward in a solution-oriented manner and enjoy a constructive error culture, we look forward to receiving your application!

Your Responsibilities

• Complaint Management: You will handle customer complaints independently and on time. In doing so, you act in a solution-oriented and professional manner to ensure customer satisfaction even in difficult cases and a high-frequency environment.

• Root Cause Analysis & Optimization: You systematically analyze the reasons for complaints in order to identify operational weaknesses and initiate sustainable process improvements.

• Solution Orientation: You make well-founded decisions regarding goodwill arrangements within defined guidelines to achieve a fast and satisfactory solution for our customers.

• Quality Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant.

• Risk Assessment: You identify potential operational or legal risks at an early stage and support their minimization.

• Interface Management: You coordinate closely with internal departments (e.g., Product, Operations) to resolve complex issues quickly and in a customer-friendly manner.

Your Profile

• Completed training, ideally in banking or insurance, the legal field, or comparable areas.

• At least 1-2 years of experience in complaint management, customer service, or handling demanding customer inquiries – ideally in the financial services industry or a comparable regulatory environment.

• Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner.

• A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Minimum C1 fluency (written and spoken) in both English and German is required. Any additional language skills are a strong plus.

• Good IT skills (especially Google Workspace, Zendesk).

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

• You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
